title: Impact of Predictive Genetic Testing
brief_summary: Analysing Impact of preemptive genetic testing on quality of life, physical activity and eating behavior at baseline and 3 months after testing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* informed consent for genetic testing
* informed consent for study participation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \<18 years
* renal replacement dependency
* pregnancy
* active cancer disease
* no informed consent for genetic testing or study participation
study_population: Healthy subjects with request for health check up at Robert-Bosch-Hospital
